info.title: Datalith API
info.description: A media store that runs as one instance, with file contents on disk and metadata and durable tasks in SQLite. Images have WebP outputs, standalone audio has AAC in M4A and optional FLAC, and video uses H.264 HLS with shared audio tracks. IDs are UUID strings, dates are UTC RFC 3339 strings, and file sizes and page totals are decimal strings. A trusted backend or reverse proxy must handle authentication. Formal client libraries are separate projects.

post.description: The service saves the upload and task before responding and does not wait for media conversion. The upload streams to disk. Without options it creates a permanent resource. Image originals are saved by default; audio and video originals are not. Video requests must specify nonempty resolution and fps pairs.

post.description: Export pauses content writes, file cleanup, and single-use claims while normal downloads continue. Archive version 2 contains a manifest, complete HLS inventory, and one copy of each unique file content, including originals, image and standalone audio outputs, and HLS initialization files and segments. Sessions, task history, settings, and temporary MP4 artifacts are not transferred.

get.description: Read the artifact of a successful export task. MP4 exports expire separately from task-history retention, after 24 hours by default; the task record remains at least until artifact expiry. Single-use MP4 exports require the same still-valid playback session and media. Normal MP4 exports use an input snapshot and can complete after source deletion, while source expiry remains applicable. HEAD ignores Range. Completed artifact reads remain available without av-convert or FFmpeg processing tools.

200.description: Compiled features, installed tool availability, output profile names, and configured limits.

X-Request-Id.description: Request ID created by the server.

get.description: Use media.audio and media.video for new upload and reprocessing availability. The av object separates external tool discovery from AAC, H.264, and FLAC encoder availability and reports the minimum tool major version and discovery failure reason. video.mp4_export follows usable tool availability and can be true without an H.264 encoder. Existing media, sessions, and completed artifact reads remain available without processing tools.

post.summary: Claim single-use audio or video playback
post.description: Claim one fixed playback session and return its secret token. Read metadata before claiming because ordinary metadata reads and lists hide consumed media. The same idempotency key retries the original session. The token permits repeated content, original, HLS, and MP4 requests until fixed expiry, at most the media expiry. Deleting media invalidates it. Ordinary media do not require a session. The first reply and idempotent retries use the same millisecond-precision expiry.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: An ASCII key stored with the task for seven days by default. The same key and input return the existing task. Different input with the same key returns 409.

Cache-Control.description: no-store for the secret session response.

post.summary: Remux an existing video version into MP4
post.description: Select an existing video identifier and the best allowed available audio in order FLAC, higher AAC, then lower AAC. A source with no audio produces video-only MP4. Existing compressed streams are copied and faststart is written; no stream is re-encoded. The task has kind mp4_export. New remuxing requires av-convert and usable FFmpeg and ffprobe version 9 or later; existing HLS, audio, sessions, and completed artifacts remain readable without that processing capability.

head.description: Open a published HLS track asset. GET supports one byte range and cache conditions after authorization; HEAD ignores Range. Single-use playback supports repeated reads with the same token and uses no-store. These reads remain available without audio/video processing tools.

MediaKind.description: A stored resource, image, standalone audio item, or HLS video. Processing availability depends on compiled features and installed tools; check capabilities.

expires_in_seconds.description: For new uploads, the lifetime starts when processing is complete and the media is saved. Processing an existing source keeps its original expiry time.

single_use.description: Resources and images allow one content GET claim. Audio and video allow one playback-session claim; the same valid token can read segments, seek, and replay. Session duration is fixed and cannot exceed media expiry.

name.description: The name must be unique in this request. The name original is reserved.

multipliers.description: The list must include 1. Each value must be at most capabilities.image.limits.max_multiplier.

ImageOptions.description: SVG and SVGZ use a renderer that does not load external images. SVG XML and embedded data share a 64 MiB limit, with at most 32 nested SVG images. SVGZ originals keep their compressed bytes and use application/gzip. Every output size still needs WebP, including trust mode; an uploaded JPEG or PNG can only replace its matching fallback. Outputs do not upscale.

kind.description: The output media kind. Defaults to image for older clients.

ProcessOptions.description: Create new image, audio, or video media from a retained original without changing the source. The original must exist. Single-use sources return 409. The result keeps the source expiry and is not published after it has expired. The same idempotency key, source ID, and options return the existing task even after the source is deleted or expires.

file_size.description: A decimal string that JavaScript can read with BigInt.

content_path.description: A relative URL for this variant, multiplier, and format.

single_use.description: One content claim for resource/image media or one playback-session claim for audio/video media.

consumed_at.description: Time the content or playback session was claimed. Ordinary metadata reads hide consumed media.

total.description: A decimal string that JavaScript can read with BigInt.

attempt.description: Number of times processing has started. This is zero before the first attempt.

result.description: Uploads and media processing return Media. TAR export returns ExportResult. MP4 export returns Mp4ExportResult. Import returns ImportResult. Results never contain playback-session tokens.

media.description: Availability for new uploads and reprocessing. Existing media reads do not depend on these processing flags.

max_file_size.description: A decimal string that JavaScript can read with BigInt.

archive_version.description: Current export archive format version, 2. Import also accepts version 1.

available.description: The external FFmpeg and ffprobe programs passed discovery and the minimum-version checks. This does not imply all encoders are available.

audio_encoder.description: AAC encoding is available for new standalone audio processing.

video_encoder.description: H.264 encoding and its required timestamp support are available for new video processing.

flac_encoder.description: FLAC encoding is available. Lossless preservation can fall back to AAC with a warning when it is needed but absent.

unavailable_reason.description: Reason external processing discovery is unavailable, or null when the tool discovery succeeded.

audio.description: Audio recipe metadata; use media.audio and av encoder flags for actual processing availability.

aac_bitrates.description: First and second target bitrates, in bits per second: 256000 then 128000.

video.description: Video recipe metadata. MP4 remux availability is independent of the video encoder flag.

bitrate.description: Global 1080p/60 fps rate limit, in bits per second.

mp4_export.description: New MP4 remux tasks can run when external tools are available, even if the H.264 encoder is not. This does not control reading completed artifacts.

seconds.description: Configured fixed playback-session lifetime, capped by media expiry.

mp4_export_retention_seconds.description: Configured completed MP4 artifact retention, independent of task-history retention.

Capabilities.description: Processing availability and configured limits. New audio/video processing requires FFmpeg and ffprobe version 9 or later and the required encoders; missing or older tools do not prevent serving existing media or using resources and compatible image processing.

ProcessingMode.description: Transcode uses the service recipe. Trust checks each file or compressed stream and reuses compliant content when possible; other outputs still encode.

ProcessingMethod.description: How this output was created. Unknown is used by older metadata; copied reuses a complete file, remuxed keeps compressed streams in a new container, and transcoded encodes from the source.

save_original.description: Keep a separate original reference for later reprocessing. Published outputs can still reference uploaded bytes when false.

preserve_lossless.description: Preserve compatible lossless samples in FLAC with original sample rate, significant bit depth, and channel count, plus AAC fallback. If samples cannot be represented, or a needed FLAC encoder is unavailable, return AAC with a warning. Lossy sources remain AAC.

audio_stream.description: The source stream index. If omitted, use the default audio stream, then the first audio stream.

AudioOptions.description: Standalone audio uses native AAC-LC at 48 kHz with a 256 kbps first choice and a 128 kbps second choice if the first compressed payload is larger than the source. The second choice may be larger than the source. No MP3 fallback is produced. Mono and stereo stay unchanged; other AAC layouts are mixed to stereo.

resolution.description: The horizontal canvas tier. Requests are adjusted downward for the source.

fps.description: The fps tier. Sources below 10 fps use 10 fps; fractional cadence is reported by the output frame_rate.

save_original.description: Keep a separate original reference for later reprocessing. Published outputs can still reference uploaded bytes when false.

preserve_lossless.description: Preserve compatible lossless samples in FLAC with original sample rate, significant bit depth, and channel count, plus AAC fallback. If samples cannot be represented, or a needed FLAC encoder is unavailable, return AAC with a warning. Lossy sources remain AAC.

audio_stream.description: The source stream index. If omitted, use the default audio stream, then the first audio stream.

variants.description: Explicit resolution and fps pairs. There is no default ladder. Identical effective outputs are combined.

VideoOptions.description: Video normally stores H.264 HLS fMP4 with separate shared audio tracks. Horizontal canvases fit content with black borders and do not enlarge, stretch, or crop it. New encoding uses x264 veryslow, CRF 23, yuv420p, progressive frames, and SDR. Bitrate is limited by service configuration and cannot be overridden here.

id.description: Audio identifier: aac_low, aac_high, or flac.

bitrate.description: Average compressed bitrate in bits per second.

content_path.description: Standalone audio content path, or a video audio track playlist path. HLS tracks have no standalone file metadata.

AudioMedia.description: Standalone AAC and optional FLAC outputs.

id.description: Existing video version and HLS track identifier, such as 1080p30.

frame_rate.description: Nominal picture cadence. Endpoint pictures can be held longer to retain source audio/video timing.

leading_hold_seconds.description: Time the first picture is held before source video starts. Omitted when zero.

codec.description: HLS codec string including the H.264 profile and level.

audio.description: Allowed shared audio track identifiers. Below 720p only aac_low is allowed; from 720p aac_high can also be allowed, and from 1080p flac can also be allowed when present.

master_path.description: Path to the default AAC master playlist.

VideoMedia.description: HLS summary without the complete segment inventory.

variant.description: An identifier from existing Media.video.variants. The task does not create a missing resolution or fps version.

token.description: Secret token passed as the session query parameter for this media and its MP4 exports. It is not placed in public Media or Task results.

expires_at.description: Fixed session expiry with millisecond precision from the first reply and on idempotent retries. The default is 24 hours after claiming, limited by media expiry, and reads do not extend it.

audio.description: The selected audio profile, or null for video-only media.

artifact_path.description: Service-root-relative download path, such as api/v1/tasks/UUID/artifact, without a playback-session credential.

expires_at.description: Fixed artifact expiry with millisecond precision. The default is 24 hours after completion, capped by source expiry and any required playback session expiry.

Error.description: An error object with a code and message. Writes paused by an export return 503 with Retry-After: 1.

X-Request-Id.description: Request ID created by the server.
